description: This file defines the NoteReadPlatformService interface in the Fineract project, specifying methods for retrieving note data related to resources.

classes.name: NoteReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to read or retrieve note data associated with resources.

methods.name: retrieveNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note based on note ID, resource ID, and note type ID.

methods.name: retrieveNotesByResource
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with a particular resource and note type.
